headline: Meta’s Muse Is Adults-Only. Why Does It Look Like a Kids’ Toy?
context: Meta says Muse is just for adults, though its cuddly, Labubu-like mascot—and upcoming Tamagotchi-style AI device—may be disarming for users of all ages.
